label: The arithmetic mean: x-bar equals one over n times the sum of the observations
The median: for odd n the middle order statistic; for even n the average of the two middle order statistics
tex: median = \begin{cases} x_{(n+1)/2} & n \text{ odd} \\ \frac{1}{2}\left(x_{(n/2)} + x_{(n/2)+1}\right) & n \text{ even} \end{cases}

label: The mode: the value with the highest frequency f(x) in the data
The mean minimizes the sum of squared deviations: the arithmetic mean is the unique value c that makes the sum of (x_i minus c) squared as small as possible
The median minimizes the sum of absolute deviations: the median is the value c that makes the sum of the distances |x_i minus c| as small as possible
The sample standard deviation: s equals the square root of the sum of squared deviations from the mean, divided by n minus 1
